title: Grateful Dead Live at Warfield Theater on 1982-02-17
lineage: MAC (Taped by Steven Martin, modified Nakamichi CM-700 mics > Sony TC-D5M on Maxell metal tape) > Nak Dragon playback > Cardas audiophile cables > HHB CDR 800 master CD > Samsung SW-232B extraction (EAC v0.9 beta 4) > tracking (CD Wave) > sector boundary

ai_review.summary: Hot Warfield ’82 show with a monster Estimated Prophet and smoking Scarlet > Fire; the audience tape captures the energy despite some hiss and occasional muffiness.
ai_review.review: The performance is widely praised as a high‑energy, jazzy set with standout moments like Estimated Prophet, Birdsong, the seamless Scarlet/Fire run and Jerry’s rare “Tiger” solo in the space leading into The Wheel.  While most listeners love the vibe, a few note that the audience recording has hiss and isn’t as clear as a soundboard source, but it remains listenable and enjoyable.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews (8 out of 11) are 4‑5 stars highlighting strong musical performance; only a couple mention sound issues, resulting in an overall high rating with consistent feedback.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Solid tape transfer with some amp hiss and occasional muddiness; not as crisp as a soundboard but generally clear enough to enjoy the show.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong opening with Minglewood into Sugaree, a grooving mid‑set Estimated Prophet and Birdsong, culminating in the fiery Scarlet/Fire sequence; the set feels tight and consistently high‑energy.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Notable for slipping in a rare “Tiger” improvisation during the space before The Wheel; overall praised for his playing throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bobby adds a unique scatting harmony during Estimated Prophet, adding extra flavor to the performance.
